# GitHub Actions

`pages.yml` verifies pull requests and publishes the assembled site on main pushes or manual runs from main. The [deployment runbook](../../deployment/README.md) covers setup, local checks and rollback.

`scope.yml` uses `pull_request_target` for PRs into main. It checks out the base commit, fetches the head as Git data, and never executes PR code. The checker compares the merge base and head, treating renames as a deletion and addition. A game PR can touch one game directory. Its existing schema-valid registry entry can change title, description and version under the standing rule while it stays private and keeps its planned or development status at the merge base, PR head and trusted base. Other editable metadata requires a field grant in the base commit's [scope policy](../../studio/production/registry-scope.json). Registration, publication, registry-only changes and Studio-only changes remain subject to Studio review. The checker classifies by changed paths; reviewers establish authorization for Studio-only changes.

For an authorized game change that needs the root lockfile, workflow or shared files, use separate Studio work where feasible. For an inseparable batch, a separate reviewed policy change on main can grant the exact head SHA and path list under `approvedHeads`. Keep the authorization narrow and run dependent-game regressions. PR labels, titles and candidate edits to the policy do not grant access. Require the trusted scope check and up-to-date branches in repository rules where available. If main advances without a fresh check, verify scope against the current trusted base before merge.

Forest Adventure S01 needed this exception for registration, the Phaser lockfile and a required Pages build step. An early rerun still used the former base SHA after the policy merged. An edited PR event verified the unchanged head against the policy-bearing base. Confirm both SHAs when troubleshooting a rerun and preserve the required check. [PR #11 and scope history](https://github.com/huynhngocsonuit2000github/ai-game-studio/pull/11)
